name: n5_b09
description: B09: zarrToN5 of a demo-sized volume (a CamB tile of the demo cell image dataset, 500 x 1800 x 512 uint16, zarr chunks 256^3; MATLAB reads its (y, x, z) array, Python the native array of the same data) to N5 with MATLAB's defaults (MATLAB writes its [nz, nx, ny] layout, Python standard N5), and N5ToZarr of each side's own N5 of that volume, tasks in the process (parseCluster false), at 24 threads. MATLAB's N5Adapter runs on zarr-python 2 and numcodecs in the active environment.
